verdict.rationale: Warp's own API docs show an official Homebrew install, `brew install TeamWarp/tap/warp`, described as a standalone binary that needs no Node.js. That points to a first-party CLI from the TeamWarp org, but it is a single thin mention with nothing on what the CLI does. Missing for 10: documentation of CLI commands and scope, evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI workflows (e.g. structured output, scripting for agents), CLI auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
